releases.name: v0.2.4
releases.body: - Added icons to various interactable objects to make them easier to tell apart visually.
releases.bodyZh: - 为多种可交互物体添加了图标，以便于视觉区分。

releases.name: v0.2.3
releases.body:
- Fixed blurry textures from latest New Horizons update
- Fixed gravity from an invisible body affecting the player intermittently
releases.bodyZh:
- 修复了最新New Horizons更新带来的模糊纹理问题
- 修复了由一个不可见物体间歇性影响玩家的重力问题

releases.name: v0.2.2
releases.body:
- Re-enabled the scout launcher but patched out the scout boost velocity bonus while in certain mod locations.
- Fixed some warp devices not activating in some circumstances.
releases.bodyZh:
- 重新启用了侦察发射器，但在某些模组位置时移除了侦察加速速度加成。
- 修复了某些情况下跃迁设备无法激活的问题。

releases.name: v0.2.1
releases.body:
- Hotfix to disable the scout launcher in most locations to prevent sequence breaking via scout boosting
- Minor visual improvements to certain props in a central location
releases.bodyZh:
- 热补丁：在大多数位置禁用侦察发射器，以防止通过侦察加速导致顺序破坏
- 对中央位置中某些道具进行微小的视觉效果改进

releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.bodyZh: 官方同人游戏提交的候选版本。
